titles.title: A Good Hand Wasted
titles.plot: A Good Hand Wasted is a psychological thriller about a group of friends whose luxury getaway to a secluded private island turns deadly when they enter a poker game where losing a hand means facing Russian roulette. Under the control of a mysterious dealer, buried secrets surface, loyalties unravel and the friends find themselves fighting to survive the next hand.

titles.title: Christmas at the Kringles
titles.plot: The story follows the Seversons, a family starting fresh in a quiet suburban neighborhood, whose next-door neighbors, the Kringles, celebrate Christmas year-round. What begins as charming quickly turns unsettling, as Mark and Julie grow concerned about their son's growing attachment to the family. After a heated confrontation, Mark heads next door to bring his family home only to uncover the Kringles' true intentions: to hypnotize and indoctrinate them. What follows is a life-or-death rescue mission, as Mark teams up with a rogue, badass Santa in a high-stakes, action-packed fight to save his family.

titles.title: Clowntergeist
titles.plot: Emma, a college student who has a crippling fear of clowns, must come face to face with her worst fear when an evil spirit in the body of a clown terrorizes her town.

titles.title: Fresh Meat
titles.plot: Gang members break out of prison and hide in a Maori family's mansion. They have no idea the family enjoys feasting on human flesh until it is too late.

titles.title: Gremlins
titles.plot: A gadget salesman is looking for a special gift for his son and finds one at a store in Chinatown. The shopkeeper is reluctant to sell him the "mogwai" but sells it to him with the warning to never expose him to bright light, water, or to feed him after midnight. All of this happens and the result is a gang of gremlins that decide to tear up the town on Christmas Eve.

titles.title: Hannibal Rising
titles.plot: After witnessing the violent deaths of his parents at the end of World War II, young Hannibal Lecter (Gaspard Ulliel) flees to his uncle's home in Paris. He learns his uncle is dead, but the man's mysterious Japanese widow, Lady Murasaki (Gong Li) welcomes him nonetheless. An aptitude for science helps Hannibal gain acceptance to medical school, where he hones the skills he needs to exact revenge for the atrocities he witnessed.

titles.title: Possessor
titles.plot: Tasya Vos, an elite, corporate assassin, takes control of other people's bodies using brain-implant technology to execute high-profile targets.

titles.title: Ralph's Perfekt Christmas
titles.plot: To win back his wife, Christmas-obsessed Ralph concocts a crazy plan to kidnap the washed-up child star of his favorite Christmas movie. His scheme goes awry and spirals darkly out of control in an outrageous dark comedy with a horror twist that reveals two sides of one very desperate man determined to have his "Perfekt Christmas," no matter what -- even if it lands him on the Naughty List.

titles.title: Stiletto
titles.plot: Stiletto follows Lyric, who on the one-year anniversary of the brutal murder of her older sister seeks retribution and works to protect the dancer community from the masked killer responsible for a wave of strip-club slayings.

titles.title: The Canvas
titles.plot: In an isolated house, Robert and his son Daniel discover a painting that seems disturbingly alive. When their darkest nightmares begin bleeding into reality, a sinister presence emerges from the canvas, feeding on buried trauma and forgotten memories. What begins as a mysterious painting soon becomes a living nightmare they cannot escape.

titles.title: The Cycle
titles.plot: When the body of a man missing for thirty-six years is discovered at the scene of a horrific crime, it's up to his estranged daughter to unravel his dark past.

titles.title: The Devils
titles.plot: In 17th-century France, Father Grandier (Oliver Reed) is a priest whose unorthodox views on sex and religion influence a passionate following of nuns, including the sexually obsessed Sister Jeanne (Vanessa Redgrave). When the power-hungry Cardinal Richelieu (Christopher Logue) realizes he must eliminate Grandier to gain control of France, Richelieu portrays Grandier as a satanist and spearheads a public outcry to destroy the once-loved priest's reputation.

titles.title: The Last Temptation of Becky
titles.plot: Now a CIA field agent, Becky (Lulu Wilson) goes undercover in Poland to infiltrate a family running an inn at The Wolf's Lair, one of Hitler's WWII bunkers. When she learns the father, Wilhelm Reuss (Neil Patrick Harris), plans to spark the Fourth Reich, Becky must stop him.

trailer.title: The Last Temptation of Becky: Exclusive Trailer 2

titles.title: Trauma or, Monsters All
titles.plot: When visiting writer Cassandra asks: "Are There Monsters Outside my Window" in the local paper, the answer leads to a traumatic showdown in the quiet town of Talbot Falls.

titles.title: #VYMARA
titles.plot: Desperate to stay relevant, four washed-up content creators livestream their search for a missing YouTuber linked to a chilling conspiracy video. As they venture deep into the woods in hopes of a fantastical herb, answers and clicks, they uncover something sinister... proving not all content is meant to go viral.
